features: 【🖥️ 18.5-INCH FULL HD IPS DISPLAY】Experience immersive visuals on a large 18.5-inch (47 cm) portable screen featuring Full HD 1920 x 1080 resolution and advanced IPS panel technology. Enjoy sharp details, vibrant images, 16.7 million colours and 178° horizontal and vertical viewing angles for consistent picture quality. With 99% sRGB colour gamut, 8-bit colour depth and 290 nits brightness, this display is ideal for office productivity, multitasking, presentations, entertainment and extending your laptop workspace.

【⚡ 100HZ REFRESH RATE & ADAPTIVESYNC】Enjoy smoother scrolling, fluid visuals and responsive performance with a refresh rate of 100Hz, supported via HDMI and USB Type-C connections. Featuring 7ms GTG response time and AdaptiveSync technology to help minimise screen tearing and stuttering during compatible content playback. HDR10 support enhances compatible HDR content, while Acer VisionCare and Flicker-Free technology help deliver comfortable viewing during extended working and entertainment sessions.

【🔌 DUAL USB TYPE-C & HDMI CONNECTIVITY】Stay connected with versatile connectivity options, including 2 USB Type-C ports, 1 HDMI 1.4 port and audio output. Connect compatible laptops, smartphones, tablets and other supported devices to extend or mirror your screen. USB Type-C offers convenient single-cable video and power connectivity when the connected device supports DisplayPort Alt Mode and supplies sufficient power. HDMI connectivity provides additional flexibility for devices with compatible video outputs, making it an excellent secondary display for productivity and entertainment.

【🎒 ULTRA-SLIM PORTABLE DESIGN & FLEXIBLE VIEWING】Designed for productivity on the move, the Acer PM191Q E combines an ultra-slim portable form factor with a spacious 18.5-inch screen. The integrated adjustable stand supports a 0° to 90° tilt range, allowing flexible screen positioning for different working environments. Whether working from home, setting up a temporary workstation, delivering presentations or expanding your laptop display, its portable design provides the convenience of an additional screen wherever a suitable power and video connection is available.

【🔊 DUAL SPEAKERS, VESA MOUNT & VISIONCARE】Enjoy convenient multimedia audio through integrated dual 1.5W speakers, eliminating the need for separate speakers for everyday listening. The monitor supports 75 x 75 mm VESA mounting for flexible installation on compatible monitor arms or wall mounts. Featuring Acer VisionCare, Flicker-Free technology, HDR10 support, 99% sRGB colour coverage and IPS wide viewing angles, the PM191Q E delivers a versatile combination of display quality, viewing comfort and practical functionality for work, study and entertainment.
